fusions.name: Thrown Milestone
fusions.desc: Heaves a milestone that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Tramp the Bedding
fusions.desc: Stamps the mortar bed flat around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hobnailed Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile of Setts
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
